notes: Event date: 10 February 1945, from first light (Ellis, vol. II, p. 262). Event definition: Having heard that the Materborn feature has been seized, General Horrocks orders the 43rd Division, with tanks of the 8th Armoured Brigade under command, to start from Nijmegen at 7 p.m. on 9 February and pass through the 15th Division for Goch, Udem and Weeze. The division leads with the 129th Brigade, using the road through Kranenburg to Nutterden; the head of the 129th takes three hours to cover the ten miles to Nutterden. Though delayed by defended road blocks and bomb craters, the leading battalion reaches Cleve shortly after first light, but very soon the whole brigade becomes involved in bitter encounters and is pinned down among the ruins of Cleve all day.
